requested_action: rotate one suspected-compromised synthetic API credential
success_conditions: replacement fingerprint differs from the old fingerprint
consumer references the replacement before old-key revocation
replacement-key canary returns HTTP 200 before old-key revocation
old-key canary returns HTTP 401 credential_revoked after revocation
independent read-back shows old revoked, replacement active, and consumer migrated
termination_conditions: stop before revocation if replacement canary fails
stop if any target differs from the approved synthetic tenant
stop if credential material becomes readable
rollback_before_revocation: restore the consumer reference to the old synthetic key and deactivate the replacement
recovery_after_revocation: request new authority for a second replacement; never reactivate the suspected-compromised key
